data.name: Inner Strength
data.description: Once per day, you may heal yourself as a swift action, healing %1d6 hit points. When you use this ability, you can also remove one of the following conditions from yourself: blinded, confused, dazzled, deafened, frightened, nauseated, shaken, sickened, or staggered.|InnerStrengthDice
